name: Daegu (South Korea, 1996–2001)
description: A blue field with a golden-orange emblem of mountain peaks and a bird over the name 'TAEGU' and the city's name in white Korean script.
history: Flag introduced on 10 October 1996 with the new emblem of Daegu Metropolitan City; the romanisation on the flag was changed from 'TAEGU' to 'DAEGU' in March 2001 under the revised romanisation of Korean, and the flag was replaced at the end of 2001.
